theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_ti_action_translation_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), (∀ β γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = fderiv ℝ (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y v) → R.action (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.action (fun y => (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (v + y)) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
